DN250 and DN300 CPVC flanges may have lower ratings as follows.  Vendor to confirm flange ratings:  38 C / 828 kPag, 65 C / 466 kPag, 71 C / 414 kPag, 76 C / 331 kPag, 82 C / 259 kPag, 93 C / 207 kPag, 98 C / 166 kPag.

For pipe diameters >DN200, fabricated fittings (not fully molded) with FRP outer reinforcement may be acceptable where service conditions permit, subject to Chemetics prior review and acceptance of the vendor fabrication standard.

Reinforcement will be an overlay of reinforced vinyl ester resin. Resin will be Derakane® 411 or approved equal.  Derakane® 510C with 5% antimony trioxide or equal to achieve an ASTM E84 Class 1 flame spread rating will be used in the last two layers of chopped strand mat. The reinforcement will be commercial grade, E type glass fiber with silane finish compatible with the resin system. The outside exposed surface of all reinforcement will be pigmented (colour to be confirmed) and contain UV inhibitors.

The outer surface of all substrate (CPVC) piping will be treated prior to overlaying to ensure adhesion between the FRP reinforcement and the CPVC pipe. Treatment will be Fabco #820 bonding agent or approved equal. Bonding agent will be applied in accordance with the manufacturer’s instructions. Reinforcement will be applied to lengths of piping to a thickness given by the table above (see ‘Overlay Thk’). The reinforcement may be applied by filament winding or hand lay up.

A double layer of chopped strand mat and resin will be applied over all pipe fittings, the hubs only of all flanges, and the overlap of adjacent pipe overlay to a distance equal to the OD of the reinforced pipe (25 minimum).
Cement socket joints with CPVC solvent cement (ASTM F493) in accordance with ASTM D2855. Stub ins, rod and fusion welding are not permitted.
Where fitting sizes are not covered by ASTM F439, the manufacturer's standard will be submitted to Chemetics for acceptance.
